Government of UP
Industrial Development Department; Section -4
No. 4406/77-4-26/193Appeal/24
Lucknow: Dated 20.08.2026

M/s Victor Component Systems Pvt. Ltd. ..... Revisionist
Vs
Greater Noida Industrial Development Authority(GNIDA) ..... Respondent

The instant revision has been filed by M/s Victor Component Systems
Pvt. Ltd. challenging the demand notice dated 27-06-2023 issued by the
Respondent Authority, whereby time extension charges have been levied. The
Revisionist does not deny that the time extension charges are payable by him.
His only prayer is limited to the fact that the time extension charges should
be applicable from the outer limit for construction as mentioned in the lease
deed. It is a settled position of law that once a binding contract is entered
between the parties, one party cannot unilaterally alter the conditions of the
contract.

The Respondent Authority agrees to this contention of the Revisionist.
The Revision is disposed of with a direction to the Authority to recalculate
the time extension charges as per the conditions mentioned in the lease deed.

1. Chief Executive Officer, GNIDA
2. M/s Victor Component Systems Pvt. Ltd.
3. Director I.T. Invest U.P. – to upload the order on the department’s website.
4. Guard file

By Order
(Nirmesh Kumar Shukla)
Joint Secretary
